avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Misoprostol causes diarrhea; magnesium supplements increase osmotic laxative effect and worsen GI adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or separate dosing by 2+ hours if necessary

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May help offset misoprostol-induced diarrhea through osmotic effects, but excessive amounts may cause drug binding
caution_supplements.action: Monitor GI tolerance; maintain consistent intake timing

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Food reduces misoprostol absorption and peak plasma concentrations; fat specifically impairs bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Administer on empty stomach; if GI upset occurs, use low-fat food only

caution_foods.name: Milk and dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: May provide mild gastroprotective effect and help offset diarrhea without significantly impairing absorption
caution_foods.action: Can be used for GI symptom management if needed

monitoring_notes: Monitor for diarrhea severity and dehydration, as this is the primary dose-limiting adverse effect. Counsel patients to take on empty stomach or with low-fat food to optimize absorption and therapeutic efficacy.
